What the heck? I noticed this happened when I weighed my hair color cream. The scale doesn't move.

This is a scale. It only has one job, and it's not doing it. I'm just disappointed that I caught this too late to return it.Do not get this! The number constantly fluctuates when something is on in it. You'll never get an exact number.
